# gzh-design-skill

The files in this directory are an embedded functional subset of
[isjiamu/gzh-design-skill](https://github.com/isjiamu/gzh-design-skill), pinned
to upstream commit `ba1f4175519b481cb3566616c9e5178705067904`.

WeSight embeds only the runtime files used by its WeChat theme generator:
`SKILL.md`, the registered theme references, the common component reference,
the custom-theme generator reference, the theme index, and the HTML validator.
